name: llama
projection_source: fixed pre-existing official SEKA synthetic QA calibration artifact; no new calibration data evaluated
projection_operator: k <- k - gamma P k, gamma in [0,1], using official pre-RoPE k_norm/k_proj placement; not a full published SEKA benchmark reproduction
green: bounded +1 attention score on gold rule ID/condition/action in P3-selected layers
hard_gate_position_alignment: gate_hard uses compact retained-token positions; gate_hard_original_positions and all finite lambda gates retain original positions
attention_mass_scope: 20 fixed SW cases, FP32 recomputation from actual query/key and final-query mask, not full-kernel attention output
